'''Dim Other's Senses''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that combined both [[Force power/Legends#Alter|Alter]] and [[Force power/Legends#Sense|Sense]] disciplines. Targets affected by this power suffered a reduction in their perception of their surroundings, allowing individuals to hide or sneak past the affected target.

The Jedi Aces held as part of their way of war that they would not use this power on the pilots they fought.<ref>[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] </ref>

While on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], a group of [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin|Sith Shadow Assassins]] used this power to dull Darth Bane's perceptions, nearly catching him off-guard and slaying him in [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|their attack]].<ref>''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Nine hundred and ninety-nine years later, Luke Skywalker used this power during [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]] [[Raid on Nomad City|against Thrawn's raiders over Nomad City]], after the battle Luke wondered if such mind-dulling powers were perhaps at least a bit [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sided]];<ref>''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> and C'Baoth, the insane cloned Jedi Master, used this power against Luke Skywalker, keeping him too dimwitted and tried to realize his brutality and madness were not of the Jedi way, then nearly making Mara Jade go to sleep and crash her ship when she came to collect Luke.<ref>''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
